name: bloom_classify
description: Classify learning objectives by the level of the revised Bloom taxonomy (Remember, Understand, Apply, Analyze, Evaluate, Create) from their main verb, in English or Spanish, with a bundled verb table built on the 19 cognitive processes of Anderson & Krathwohl (2001). Recognises inflected forms, names the taxonomy process, flags verbs listed at more than one level and non-measurable verbs such as understand or know, and summarises the levels of a list.

objectives: Students will be able to compare the French and American revolutions

catalog.source: Anderson & Krathwohl (eds.), A Taxonomy for Learning, Teaching, and Assessing: A Revision of Bloom's Taxonomy of Educational Objectives, 2001, Table 5.1 (the cognitive process dimension); Krathwohl, Theory Into Practice 2002;41(4):212-218. Verb table compiled for this tool
